parent_links.lineage: scale-up of the #132 adapter (larger corpus, menu-order augmentation, 1 seed) evaluated on the validated #135 panel with pre-registered margins

training_seeds_note: ticket edited to '1 seed (to speed up)': seeds 17/29/71 read as seed 17 only; 2 cells

visual-choice-frontier.legend: Static task context, the initial-state scene and the partial-goal pages are attached, followed by one unlabelled 128px scene per frontier state in menu order, each labelled frontier-choice (label c<i>). Initial/current states are unlabelled 128px scenes without text annotations. Black robot silhouettes identify the agent. Goal constraints do not describe a complete solved state: unspecified facts are unconstrained. Goal blocks ALL, ANY, NOT, FOR EVERY and THERE EXISTS retain their labelled variable scopes. The frontier menu lists one choice label per live frontier state, unscored, in a seeded permuted order; no state identifiers, scalar search values, scores, membership flags, search memory, accepted deltas or search history are provided. The policy selects which frontier state the trusted runtime expands next; selecting the goal state solves the task.
visual-choice-frontier.system_message: Emit exactly one frontier expansion choice. The trusted runtime owns h_add, scalar priority, duplicate detection, the frontier, and state transitions. Your choice selects which frontier state the runtime expands next; selecting the goal state solves the task.

contract.rule: the trusted runtime owns the frontier; the policy selects which live frontier state to expand next; on acceptance the runtime performs the expansion atomically, inheriting candidate generation order, serial assignment and admission from BestFirstController; selecting a goal state solves the task
contract.expansion_atomicity: ChoiceFrontierController.expand_member pops the chosen member from _frontier_entries and runs the same candidate/serial/admission path as start_expansion + apply_operation + finish_expansion; per-candidate admissions are runtime-internal, not policy decisions

menu.permutation: seeded Fisher-Yates over the generation-serial member order; labels c0..cK assigned after permutation
menu.binding_visibility: refs never enter the payload; binding is stored per decision in the episode events and used by the views layer to bind scenes to labels

budget.rule: decision_cap = expansion_cap = 2 x reference_expansions; controller max_budget charges expansions and rejections

contract.goal_at_selection: selecting a live frontier member that satisfies the goal terminates the episode goal_reached without an expansion

training_tasks.extension_rule: only if < 1024 records per algorithm after the primary seeds; once
training_tasks.walk_order: seed-major: for seed ascending, the 24 strata in (domain, difficulty) order (ambiguity resolution; see protocol doc)

corpus.records_rule: one record per exact_reference choice-contract decision (goal selection included) whose menu offers >= 2 states and passes the 32K token gate; first 64 eligible decisions per (task, algorithm) in episode order; walk tasks, stop at the target; last task may be partial
corpus.teacher: ChoiceFrontierModelSession arm exact_reference seed 17, derived from PDDL, uncapped
corpus.diagnostic_rule: next 16 eligible records in walk order after the target; unaugmented; teacher-forced eval only

augmentation.rule: random.Random(seed).shuffle over the record's menu states in runtime menu order; relabel c0..cK in the new order; target = label of the teacher (heap-head) state after permutation
augmentation.check: target-is-last share within +/-5 percentage points of mean(1/menu_size); else fix code, rerun prepare/audit-prepare, max 3 fixes, then blocked exit

runtime_projection.rule: projected seconds per cell = samples x 2.75 x (mean input tokens / 4867.08); if > 18000 apply the record ladder 1536 then 1024 (prefix of walk order); keep 1024 if still over

corpus.views: per-task scene catalog of both algorithms' truncated teacher episodes; collect_task_scenes at http://127.0.0.1:18092 + prepare_expanded_views goal pages + materialize_task scene-only static pages

training.recipe: study-v5 training block via train_visual; only the corpus, augmentation, sample order and seed differ from #132
training.audit: r==64, alpha==128, steps==ceil(samples/32), seed, record count, sample count

smoke_gate.subset_rule: three cheapest tasks of the frozen 9-task panel (same subset as the native-arms v3 smoke gate)
smoke_gate.measure: schema_valid_grounded_rate = accepted calls / total calls across the 6 episodes
smoke_gate.rule: PASS iff rate >= 0.5; FAIL gates the arm's model evaluation out and that is the reported outcome

evaluation.decision_cap: 2 x R_t, R_t = membership reference_costs[alg]['expansions'] (uncapped exact_reference expansions, the #133/#135 R_t); simultaneously decision and expansion cap
evaluation.replay: finalize independently replays every v3 model episode; 0 mismatches, 0 missing

analysis.primary: D = mean over seeds of M1(learned, seed) - M1(random_valid)

decision_rule.POSITIVE: lo > 0 and D >= 0.05 and every seed point estimate > 0

secondary: teacher heap-head agreement minus chance per seed with task-cluster CI
ladder_position vs #135 exact / eps-0.25/0.50/0.75 / random M1

execution_contract.runtime_enforced_caps: 2 x reference_expansions for decisions and expansions; pretrained_base hard 1-call cap
execution_contract.resume: partial-episode journals resume interrupted bindings; completed episodes retain only after identity check + replay
execution_contract.relaunch: infrastructure failures only, at most 2 relaunches per job, recipe never changes
